sources.note: Confirms modality = deaf sign language, alt. names OCMSL / Old / Original Chiangmai Sign Language, AES nearly extinct (all users over 65 per Woodward et al. 2015); one descriptive reference only. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Woodward, James & Thanu Wongchai. 2015. Original Chiang Mai Sign Language. In J. Bakken Jepsen et al. (eds.), Sign Languages of the World: A Comparative Handbook, 687-700. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton.
